description:

- Input and maintenance of Sales & Purchase Ledger.

- Day-to-day management of Quickbooks accounts database
- Management of subscriptions/prepayments/accruals.
- Auditing of SG Accounts procedures for SIA audits
- Other financial support as requested by the Finance Manager/CFO, including but not limited to the provision of details of supplier payments, some credit control, quarterly reconciliations.
- Internal Client assistance helping ops dealing with supplier queries or Sales invoices to clients.

To be considered for the role of you will be available immediately and have previous experience in a similar varied accounts role and ideally AAT level 2 or above. You should be a self-starter, able to work well under pressure meeting deadlines, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced changeable environment.

Please send your CV for immediate consideration.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Job Overview

An established organisation is seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join its friendly and professional People and Payroll team. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-focused Payroll Administrator to support the accurate and timely processing of payroll for approximately 600 permanent employees.

The successful Payroll Administrator will work closely with the Payroll Manager and wider People team, supporting a range of payroll and pension administration activities. The role will involve monthly payroll processing, employee queries, pensions administration, payroll data preparation and ensuring payroll processes are completed accurately and within strict deadlines.

This position would suit an organised and proactive Payroll Administrator with previous payroll or HR administration experience who is keen to develop their knowledge of payroll legislation and employee benefits within a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Monthly Payroll

Assist the Payroll Manager with end-to-end monthly payroll processing.

Prepare and input payroll information for submission to an external payroll provider.

Ensure employee payments are processed accurately and on time in line with payroll deadlines.

Check payroll data and identify discrepancies or missing information.

Respond to routine employee payroll queries and requests for information.

Manage and monitor the payroll inbox, ensuring queries are dealt with promptly and professionally.

Maintain accurate and confidential employee payroll records.

Assist with the preparation and collation of payroll information for European employees.

Commission & Quarterly Payroll

Download individual salesperson activity and payroll data from business systems to support quarterly commission calculations.

Assist with the preparation and checking of quarterly commission payment information.

Ensure payroll and commission data is accurate and submitted within required deadlines.

Pension Administration

Support the administration of workplace pension schemes and auto-enrolment processes.

Prepare and send monthly pension communications to new starters.

Manage pension-related employee queries, including requests to opt in, opt out or take a pension contribution holiday.

Maintain accurate pension records and ensure relevant information is processed correctly.

Support the wider People team with pension administration and employee lifecycle processes.

HR & People Administration

Support the People and Payroll Manager with general employee administration.

Send regular communications and information to new starters.

Assist with employee lifecycle processes, ensuring relevant payroll and People documentation is completed accurately.

Work collaboratively with colleagues across the People, HR and Finance functions.

Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and payroll information.

Skills & Experience

Previous experience working as a Payroll Administrator or in a similar payroll, HR or finance administration role.

Previous experience of payroll processing is highly desirable.

Good understanding of UK payroll legislation, including PAYE, Income Tax, National Insurance and statutory payments.

Knowledge of workplace pensions and auto-enrolment requirements.

Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when working with payroll data.

Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple tasks, employee queries and competing deadlines within a fast-paced environment.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Confident working independently while also contributing effectively to a wider team.

Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to work with spreadsheets and payroll data.

Strong IT and data-handling skills.

High level of confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive employee information.

A positive, adaptable and proactive approach to problem solving.

Willingness to develop knowledge of payroll legislation and best practice.

Working Environment & Benefits

Full-time position within a professional People and Payroll team.

Opportunity to develop experience across payroll, pensions and HR administration.

Exposure to end-to-end payroll processes and employee lifecycle administration.

Supportive team environment with opportunities for professional development.

Salary and benefits package dependent on experience and seniority.

title: Payroll Coordinator
description:
Payroll Coordinator

Impact Food Group

At Impact Food Group, we re more than just a school caterer. We re on a mission to create a positive food culture and help more students enjoy healthier, better-quality food. Making a positive social impact is at the heart of everything we do. We re constantly learning, evolving, and improving every way, every day.

We one of England s fastest-growing school food providers, serving around one million students every day across more than 1,500 schools. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality, nutritious meals that support student wellbeing and enjoyment.

Our brands include Innovate, Cucina, Chapter One (Independent Schools), Hutchison, and Dolce, reflecting our breadth of experience and reach across the school catering sector.

We re now looking for a talented and highly organised Payroll Coordinator to join and play a vital role in supporting our business.

Guided by our values, integrity, bold, impactful, humble and community; you will help us shape a workplace and culture we can all be proud of.

What you ll be Doing

We are looking for a Payroll Coordinator?to assist and work alongside the team and Payroll Manager with the smooth running of the Payroll Department.

While the most important task for a payroll team is ensuring that all employees are paid on time and with the correct amount, there are also other important duties which must be performed. This includes the distribution of many important forms and reports, many of which are essential for tax purposes.

Key Responsibilities:
- Working within a busy payroll team
- Is able to work to tight deadlines and prioritise workloads in order to reach the payroll turnaround.
- Working closely with the current outsourced provider (iTrent) to ensure a prompt and efficient payroll and pension service ensuring compliance with legislation and reporting requirements.
- Including checking the administration of starters, leavers, for both payroll and pensions, along with any other adhoc administrative tasks.
- Submitting ALL Pension on a monthly basis in a timely manner, compliant to the relevant legislation and delivered in accordance with strict deadlines, along with communication with Pension stakeholders.

What are we looking for?
- The ability to work well under pressure, and comfortable in a very flexible, fast paced working environment.
- A proactive approach and able to work under own initiative and within a team.
